statement: For every cover whose geometric Galois closure is an l-group, the natural H^(l) embeds openly in P_l and its fixed subgroup under any open Delta0 preserving H is exactly the selected cusp inertia. This computes all D8/Q8 genus-three and D8 genus-two fixed subgroups at l=2.
depends_on: R1 (attached LM8 G.10); finite-index invariance of IA fixed subgroups; induced pro-l topology for l-group Galois closure
notes: The extension from Delta to arbitrary open Delta0 is proved independently: an IA automorphism of a free pro-l group has no nontrivial finite orbit, by torsion-free lower-central graded pieces. In the listed covers the fixed subgroup maps to <c^2> in original P2. All packet sections included; no commutation of fixed points with a quotient is assumed.
